name: status-line
description: A status row above the prompt in the Desktop app: the session's context fill (amber at 200k, red at 250k), and the computer, git account and branch it runs on

home_host.title: Home computer
home_host.description: The short hostname (hostname -s) of your main computer. It draws dim and any other computer draws in blue, so a remote session stands out. Leave empty to draw every hostname dim.
